title: Capvision Partners HKEX IPO (Ticker: 810221) Remains Pending After Multi-Year Filing Process
summary: Shanghai-based Capvision Partners has ticker 810221 reserved on the HKEX after multiple filing attempts since 2021, originally aiming to raise $300M at a $1.5-3B valuation. The IPO stalled after offices were raided in late 2022 and state broadcaster CCTV aired a crackdown report in May 2023 accusing the firm of helping leak sensitive information. As of late 2025, the company remains privately held with no confirmed listing date.
